discussion.body: Roster lock for discussion. Two mains: Cael Ward (FEAT-027), Liraen Quill (FEAT-028). Eight main-side: Rook Fenn (029), Brann Dur (030), Seris Vale (031), Nym Hale (032), Ash Korv (033), Ysolde Rhea (034), Halric Bent (035), Maera Sol (036). Active battle party remains three. Full available roster is ten names, two of them unkillable. Halric and Maera were added to meet the main-side count of eight.
